proposals.before: Yi Leitu fought alongside Assistant Military Governor Agui, took three stockades, and killed more than five thousand of the enemy.
proposals.after: Yi Leitu fought alongside Assistant Military Governor Aligun, took three stockades, and killed more than five thousand of the enemy.
proposals.reason: Chinese 阿里袞 is Aligun, not Agui (阿桂); the idiomatic English conflates two distinct officials.

proposals.before: Governor-General Agui's force arrived as well; operating on separate lines they rounded up the rebels until every band was taken.
proposals.after: Governor-General Aligun's force arrived as well; operating on separate lines they rounded up the rebels until every band was taken.
proposals.reason: Chinese 阿里袞 is Aligun, not Agui (阿桂); keep distinct from 阿桂 later in the chapter.

proposals.before: Torghut Khan Oboi, Taiji Cebeke Duolji, and others led more than thirty thousand households of their people back to allegiance, having sent envoys ahead to Ili with letters of submission.
proposals.after: Torghut Khan Ubashi, Taiji Cebeke Duolji, and others led more than thirty thousand households of their people back to allegiance, having sent envoys ahead to Ili with letters of submission.
proposals.reason: Chinese 渥巴錫 is Ubashi (Torghut khan); Oboi conventionally renders 鼇拜 and misidentifies him.

proposals.before: He died in the twenty-fifth year of Qianlong and was posthumously titled Qinmin.
proposals.after: He died in the twenty-fifth year of Qianlong and was posthumously titled Qinque.
proposals.reason: Posthumous title 勤愨 is Qinque; Qinmin would correspond to 勤敏.

decisions.reason: s0038 names the co-commander 參贊大臣阿里袞. Agui renders 阿桂, a different official; Aligun is the correct English for 阿里袞.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 伊勒圖偕參贊大臣阿里袞與戰

decisions.reason: s0085 has 總督阿里袞, not 阿桂. The prior idiomatic misnames him Agui; Aligun matches the Chinese and keeps him distinct from Agui elsewhere.
s0041 names 土爾扈特汗渥巴錫. Ubashi is the Torghut khan; Oboi is the conventional rendering of 鼇拜 and wrongly identifies him.
s0089 gives the posthumous title 勤愨. Qinque matches 愨; Qinmin would correspond to 勤敏 and is unsupported.
